name: First Trust Bloomberg Artificial Intelligence ETF

prospectus.objective: The First Trust Bloomberg Artificial Intelligence ETF (the Fund ) seeks investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield (before the Funds fees and expenses) of an index called the Bloomberg Artificial Intelligence Index (the Index ).
prospectus.strategy: "Under normal market conditions, the Fund will invest at least 80% of its net assets (plus any borrowings for investment purposes) in the securities that comprise the Index. The Fund, using an indexing investment approach, attempts to replicate, before fees and expenses, the total return performance of the Index, which includes dividends paid by the securities in the Index. The Fund will generally employ a full replication strategy, meaning that it will normally invest in all of the securities comprising the Index in proportion to their weightings in the Index. The Index is developed, maintained and sponsored by Bloomberg Index Services Limited (the Index Provider ). While the Index Provider may consult with First Trust Advisors L.P. ( First Trust ), the Funds investment advisor, prior to effectuating a material change to the Index methodology, First Trust maintains no discretion with regard to the compilation and composition of the Index or any changes thereto as such discretion ultimately lies with the Index Provider. The Index is constructed to track the performance of companies that develop or facilitate solutions such as deep learning (a method that teaches computers to process data the way the brain does), machine learning (the use and development of computer systems that learn and adapt without following explicit instructions, by using algorithms and statistical models to analyze and draw inferences from patterns in data), natural language processing (the combination of linguistics and computer science to help computers understand and generate human language), and image and speech recognition (deep learning algorithms that can recognize, summarize, translate, predict, and generate content using massive datasets). Such solutions in the aggregate are defined by the Index and the Fund as Artificial Intelligence. The Index selects the top 50 companies based on a combination of the Revenue Assessment (discussed below) and market capitalization of companies stemming from Artificial Intelligence products and services utilizing data from Bloomberg Intelligence ( BI ). The Indexs starting universe consists of all the securities comprising the Bloomberg World Aggregate Index, which is a float market- cap weighted equity benchmark that covers the top 99+% of market cap of the measured market. In order to be included in the Index, a security must be in the Artificial Intelligence ecosystem, as determined by BI. BI applies a review and analysis process across the identified universe to inform BIs view on each companys current, and potential near-term, relevancy to the Artificial Intelligence ecosystem across two core categories: (1) revenue exposure and (2) theme exposure. BI assesses a companys revenue exposure and theme exposure through a Revenue Assessment and Theme Assessment, respectively.
